notes: Hit@5 saturates at 1.0 across the alpha sweep on the current 25-case golden set; the index is small enough that BM25, dense, and any hybrid all surface an acceptable source within top-5.
Semantic rerank lifts MRR@10 from 0.96 -> 0.98 at the default alpha, so rerank is left ON by default.

Default alpha=0.65 (dense-leaning with lexical tie-break) is kept as the production-shaped value; the choice does not move the metric on this corpus, so it is governed by behaviour-as-corpus-grows rather than measured uplift today.
